Returns 

  • After your return is processed, you’ll receive a refund within 3 working days on the original payment method used. For more info, read our refund policy below.
  • Sometimes, the Track & Trace information shows we’ve received your return, but you haven’t received an email confirmation yet. We strive to process your return within 48 hours. This excludes Saturdays and Sundays.
  • We cannot accept returned products with visible traces of usage, missing parts or a missing / damaged original packaging. In these cases, we’ll send the product back to you.

Holidays return policy

During the festive season we have an extended returns policy. You now have up until 31st January to return orders placed between November 13th and 24th December, so you don't have to worry about being able to return items that aren't exactly what you wanted. You'll receive a refund via the original payment method.

Please note: The extended returns policy only applies to products that are unused and still in their original packaging. 

Conditions & exceptions
Not sure if your product can be returned? Then view the return conditions and exceptions. Still not quite sure? Contact us.

Conditions:

  • All goods must be unused, unopened, inactivated, in a saleable condition and in their original packaging with all labels still attached.
  • Returning an item is possible up until 30 days from the date mentioned on the purchase invoice;
  • The product is complete, unused, undamaged and in the original packaging;
  • When the return concerns a combined deal or a bundled product, it’s only possible to return the complete combined deal or bundle.

Exceptions which cannot be returned:

  • Items or products with signs of usage or mounting;
  • Products that have been opened or unsealed
  • Items or products with missing or damaged original packaging;
  • Products with software of which the seal has been broken;
  • Electronic and GPS devices that have been registered or used and therefore warranty activated;
  • Clothing that has been washed or shows signs of use;
  • Products that cannot be returned for health or hygiene reasons;
  • Products that have been registered to your name
  • Products that are clearly personal in nature;
  • Products that spoil or age quickly;
  • Products that are custom made for you, ordered on demand, not in stock and pre-ordered on your request; products or a variant of a product that are not on our site and specially ordered from the manufacturer/distributor for you. This includes Pissei custom clothing orders.
  • Products returned in an unsatisfactory condition;
  • Digital Gift Card

Refunds (if applicable) 
Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. 
If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds (if applicable) 
If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again. 
Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted. 
Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted. 
If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at retail@cigalacycling.com.

Exchanges (if applicable) 
We do not exchange products. We want to ensure you receive a product as quickly as possible. To make this possible, you can instead return a product and place a new order for the right product immediately.

You’ll get a refund for the returned item within 3 working days after we’ve received and processed your return.

Delays and Non-delivery.
Date quoted for delivery is an estimate only;
In the event Buyer contests delivery, buyer must request a proof of delivery from seller within ninety (90) days of the date of order, otherwise delivery shall be deemed completed. Claims received beyond this period will be refused.


In the event that buyer fails/refuses to take delivery, Cigala Cycling Ltd will deliver back the goods in consignment at Buyer's costs and expenses.

Ireland: €10 per package

EU: €35 per package 

The above fee is for each standard package. If the delivery include multiple packages. The fee is calculated based on the above figure, multiplied by the number of packages. 
For bulky and heavy items such indoor trainers, indoor trainer accessories, bikes and scooters, the fees are:

Ireland: €25 per package 

EU: €60 per package 

Shipping 
To return your product, you should mail your product to: 

Cigala Cycling Limited
Killeens, Clonard
Wexford
Co. Wexford
Y35 F5C3
Republic Of Ireland

Simply leave a note inside the package with your order number and reason for returning.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item.
Original shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of the original shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you, may vary.

You must consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Please note that for faulty goods we will arrange the shipment back to us.
However, please also note that packages, during shipping, might get damaged due to nature outside our control or even the courier control (road conditions, weather, warehousing conditions, handling, human error).
When receiving a package, and signing off to the courier the receival of the package you automatically accept the conditions.
If you realise afterwards that the product inside the package is damaged, please notify us a soon as possible so that we can get in touch with the courier. This should be done no later than 14 days from the delivery date since most courier companies have this maximum window to make any claims.
However, please note the if only the outside box is damaged and the product is in immaculate conditions, couriers nor ourselves take responsibility once the box has been accepted and signed during delivery. 

Canceling an order
If you want to cancel an order before we have dispatched, please email us at: retail@cigalacycling.com

Please note that we pride ourselves on our quick turnaround time, this does mean there is only a small window to cancel your order. If you notice a mistake please cancel as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

Although we will try our best to assist you we cannot guarantee we will be able to stop your order in time to prevent it from being dispatched.

Orders that have already been processed and dispatched can be canceled within 14 days of being received and must then be returned to Cigala Cycling Retail within a further 14 days as per your consumer rights.
You have rights under The Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013 which state that up to 14 days after receiving your goods, in most cases, you can change your mind and get a full refund. You have the right to cancel this contract within 14 days from delivery without giving any reason. This right does not apply to any customised or personalised goods bought through our website. To exercise this right please contact us prior to the expiry of the cancellation rights period.

If you cancel this contract, we will reimburse to you all payments received from you, including the costs of delivery (except for the supplementary costs arising if you chose a type of delivery other than the least expensive type of standard delivery offered by us). However, you are responsible for paying the return delivery charges.

We may make a deduction from the reimbursement for loss in value of any goods supplied, if the loss is the result of unnecessary handling by you.

We will make the reimbursement without undue delay, and not later than:

14 days after the day we received back from you any goods supplied; or
(if earlier) 14 days after the day you provide evidence that you have returned the goods; or
if there were no goods supplied, 14 days after the day on which we are informed about your decision to cancel this contract.
We will make the reimbursement using the same means of payment as you used for the initial transaction, unless you have expressly agreed otherwise; in any event, you will not incur any fees as a result of the reimbursement.

Once the order has been canceled you will receive a confirmation email. If not dispatched orders that have been paid at checkout will be automatically refunded, any other payment methods would not have been charged so would not be due a refund. Orders that have been dispatched will be refunded at the point the good are received back with us. Unfortunately orders that have been canceled cannot be reactivated, so if you change your mind, please place a new order in the usual way.

The item must be:

-In saleable and undamaged condition;
-In its original unopened and sealed packaging; and

This policy is in addition to, and is not intended to limit, any rights or remedies you may have under the Consumer Guarantees Act.
This policy does not impact your rights where a product may be faulty, damaged, or incorrectly supplied. If an item is faulty/damaged/incorrectly supplied, we will meet our obligations under the Consumer Guarantees Act to provide a remedy.
Faulty goods, depending on the manufacturer would normally have a 2 years EU warranty from the date of purchase.
Your warranty begins with your purchase date. Should you need to file a claim and receive a replacement unit, the warranty period on the replacement unit will continue from your original purchase date.
This covers manufacturing defects, but does not cover damage sustained by crashing, abuse, or general wear and tear. If you think your goods are faulty please contact us prior to returning them.


Cigala Cycling is a retailer, not a wholesaler. Our aim is to inspire everybody, every day and everywhere to experience the joy of sport, not to act as a wholesaler supporting B2B sales. As such, we reserve the right to cancel excessive orders of individual products without notice. Please contact customer service for further information on this matter.

Pre-order policy
When you place a pre-order with us, we contact the appropriate distributor and place the order. If the item is available, we will then get order confirmation which we then confirm with you, along with the ETA. At this point, we have committed to the pre-order and can no longer cancel the item without penalty. Therefore, please be very sure when placing your pre-order as there are cancellation fees incurred if you change your mind. The cancellation fee for a pre-order is equal to 30% of the total amount, which for some orders of large amounts such as bikes, that is the non-refundable deposit that is required when placing the pre-order.

Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA)
ETA's can vary and are not guaranteed arrival date. We list the date given by manufacturer, but delays can and do happen. We cannot cancel your pre-order, even if delays are substantial, so please take this into account when ordering. We regularly update the product listing with the latest ETA. Keep an eye on the listings after you order to see when your product is due to arrive.

Settling a Pre-Order When It Arrives
When your item arrives we will contact you to settle any balance due and arrange shipping.
Orders must be settled within 7 days of the product coming into stock. Failure to settle within this period may mean you lose your pre-ordered item.

Prices quoted can be subject to change as items are only billed by manufacturers when they ship to us. We do everything we can to give you an accurate buy price, but pre-orders that are far away can vary in price if exchange rate varies from now until then. 

Postage fees can also vary depending on the size of the product, type of shipping and number of boxes required. We suggest you pre-order each item individually as that way each pre-order's postage is paid separately and can ship as it comes into stock.

KICKR BIKE Return Terms & Conditions
Because of the size and weight of the KICKR BIKE, when returning KICKR BIKE (New, inactivated) due to changing your mind, you will be charged a restocking fee of €225. This fee is inclusive of the costs associated with any packing material to secure the KICKR BIKE for return shipment. You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning the item.

CYCLING HOLIDAYS REFUND/CANCELLATION POLICY AND TERMS & CONDITIONS

Should you need to cancel your trip, please inform us by emailing us at travel@cigalacycling.com

When booking your trip, a deposit is collected. Deposits for cycling holidays are not refundable. 
Non refundable are also events/gran fondo entry registrations.
Balances are collected 31 days (via card or bank transfer - no other payment methods such as installments, one4all etc are allowed) from the departure date, and are subject to the following cancellation policy:

  • For cancellations made between the deposit date and 31 days prior departure, a full credit of your balance (not including the initial deposit) will be carried forward for a future trip, to be used within two years.
  • For cancellations made fewer than 31 days before the trip no refunds can be issued. For this reason, we highly recommend travel insurance. 

Credits can be used towards a new balance only. A new deposit will be required for each new booking.

Privacy policy



Last updated: December 10, 2024

This Privacy Policy describes how Cigala Cycling (the "Site", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and discloses your personal information when you visit, use our services, or make a purchase from retail.cigalacycling.com (the "Site") or otherwise communicate with us regarding the Site (collectively, the "Services"). For purposes of this Privacy Policy, "you" and "your" means you as the user of the Services, whether you are a customer, website visitor, or another individual whose information we have collected pursuant to this Privacy Policy.

Please read this Privacy Policy carefully.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, including to reflect changes to our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will post the revised Privacy Policy on the Site, update the "Last updated" date and take any other steps required by applicable law.

How We Collect and Use Your Personal Information

To provide the Services, we collect and have collected over the past 12 months personal information about you from a variety of sources, as set out below. The information that we collect and use varies depending on how you interact with us.

In addition to the specific uses set out below, we may use information we collect about you to communicate with you, provide or improve or improve the Services, comply with any applicable legal obligations, enforce any applicable terms of service, and to protect or defend the Services, our rights, and the rights of our users or others.

What Personal Information We Collect

The types of personal information we obtain about you depends on how you interact with our Site and use our Services. When we use the term "personal information", we are referring to information that identifies, relates to, describes or can be associated with you. The following sections describe the categories and specific types of personal information we collect.

Information We Collect Directly from You

Information that you directly submit to us through our Services may include:

  • Contact details including your name, address, phone number, and email.
  • Order information including your name, billing address, shipping address, payment confirmation, email address, and phone number.
  • Account information including your username, password, security questions and other information used for account security purposes.
  • Customer support information including the information you choose to include in communications with us, for example, when sending a message through the Services.

Some features of the Services may require you to directly provide us with certain information about yourself. You may elect not to provide this information, but doing so may prevent you from using or accessing these features.

Information We Collect about Your Usage

We may also automatically collect certain information about your interaction with the Services ("Usage Data"). To do this, we may use cookies, pixels and similar technologies ("Cookies"). Usage Data may include information about how you access and use our Site and your account, including device information, browser information, information about your network connection, your IP address and other information regarding your interaction with the Services.

Information We Obtain from Third Parties

Finally, we may obtain information about you from third parties, including from vendors and service providers who may collect information on our behalf, such as:

  • Companies who support our Site and Services, such as Shopify.
  • Our payment processors, who collect payment information (e.g., bank account, credit or debit card information, billing address) to process your payment in order to fulfill your orders and provide you with products or services you have requested, in order to perform our contract with you.
  • When you visit our Site, open or click on emails we send you, or interact with our Services or advertisements, we, or third parties we work with, may automatically collect certain information using online tracking technologies such as pixels, web beacons, software developer kits, third-party libraries, and cookies.

Any information we obtain from third parties will be treated in accordance with this Privacy Policy. Also see the section below, Third Party Websites and Links.

How We Use Your Personal Information

  • Providing Products and Services. We use your personal information to provide you with the Services in order to perform our contract with you, including to process your payments, fulfill your orders, to send notifications to you related to your account, purchases, returns, exchanges or other transactions, to create, maintain and otherwise manage your account, to arrange for shipping, facilitate any returns and exchanges and other features and functionalities related to your account. We may also enhance your shopping experience by enabling Shopify to match your account with other Shopify services that you may choose to use. In this case, Shopify will process your information as set forth in its Privacy Policy and Consumer Privacy Policy.
  • Marketing and Advertising. We may use your personal information for marketing and promotional purposes, such as to send marketing, advertising and promotional communications by email, text message or postal mail, and to show you advertisements for products or services. This may include using your personal information to better tailor the Services and advertising on our Site and other websites. shopPolicies.title: Refund policy
shopPolicies.body:
Refund Policy

-----

Returns 

  • After your return is processed, you’ll receive a refund within 3 working days on the original payment method used. For more info, read our refund policy below.
  • Sometimes, the Track & Trace information shows we’ve received your return, but you haven’t received an email confirmation yet. We strive to process your return within 48 hours. This excludes Saturdays and Sundays.
  • We cannot accept returned products with visible traces of usage, missing parts or a missing / damaged original packaging. In these cases, we’ll send the product back to you.

Holidays return policy

During the festive season we have an extended returns policy. You now have up until 31 January to return orders placed between 1 and 24 December, so you don't have to worry about being able to return items that aren't exactly what you wanted. You'll receive a refund via the original payment method.

Please note: The extended returns policy only applies to products that are unused and still in their original packaging. Products with a '30 day satisfaction guarantee' label or a 'guaranteed fit' label that have been tested or tried out unfortunately do not fall under the extended returns policy -the normal 30 day return period applies to these products.

Conditions & exceptions
Not sure if your product can be returned? Then view the return conditions and exceptions. Still not quite sure? Contact us.

Conditions:

  • All goods must be unused, unopened, inactivated, in a saleable condition and in their original packaging with all labels still attached.
  • Returning an item is possible up until 30 days from the date mentioned on the purchase invoice;
  • The product is complete, unused, undamaged and in the original packaging;
  • When the return concerns a combined deal or a bundled product, it’s only possible to return the complete combined deal or bundle.

Exceptions which cannot be returned:

  • Items or products with signs of usage or mounting;
  • Products that have been opened or unsealed
  • Items or products with missing or damaged original packaging;
  • Products with software of which the seal has been broken;
  • GPS devices that have been registered or used;
  • Clothing that has been washed or shows signs of use;
  • Products that cannot be returned for health or hygiene reasons;
  • Products that have been registered to your name
  • Products that are clearly personal in nature;
  • Products that spoil or age quickly;
  • Products that are custom made for you, ordered on demand, not in stock and pre-ordered on your request; products or a variant of a product that are not on our site and specially ordered from the manufacturer for you. This includes Pissei custom clothing orders.
  • Products returned in an unsatisfactory condition;

Refunds (if applicable) 
Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. 
If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds (if applicable) 
If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again. 
Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted. 
Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted. 
If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at retail@cigalacycling.com.

Exchanges (if applicable) 
We do not exchange products. We want to ensure you receive a product as quickly as possible. To make this possible, you can instead return a product and place a new order for the right product immediately.

You’ll get a refund for the returned item within 3 working days after we’ve received and processed your return.

Delays and Non-delivery.
Date quoted for delivery is an estimate only;
In the event Buyer contests delivery, buyer must request a proof of delivery from seller within ninety (90) days of the date of order, otherwise delivery shall be deemed completed. Claims received beyond this period will be refused.


In the event that buyer fails/refuses to take delivery, Cigala Cycling Ltd will deliver back the goods in consignment at Buyer's costs and expenses.

Ireland: €7 per package

EU: €19 per package 

The above fee is for each standard package. If the delivery include multiple packages. The fee is calculated based on the above figure, multiplied by the number of packages. 
For bulky and heavy items such indoor trainers, indoor trainer accessories, bikes and scooters, the fees are:

Ireland: €25 per package 

EU: €49 per package 

Shipping 
To return your product, you should mail your product to: 

Cigala Cycling Limited
Killeens, Clonard
Wexford
Co. Wexford
Y35 F5C3
Republic Of Ireland

Simply leave a note inside the package with your order number and reason for returning.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item.
Original shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of the original shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you, may vary.

You must consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Please note that for faulty goods we will arrange the shipment back to us.
However, please also note that packages, during shipping, might get damaged due to nature outside our control or even the courier control (road conditions, weather, warehousing conditions, handling, human error).
When receiving a package, and signing off to the courier the receival of the package you automatically accept the conditions.
If you realise afterwards that the product inside the package is damaged, please notify us a soon as possible so that we can get in touch with the courier. This should be done no later than 14 days from the delivery date since most courier companies have this maximum window to make any claims.
However, please note the if only the outside box is damaged and the product is in immaculate conditions, couriers nor ourselves take responsibility once the box has been accepted and signed during delivery. 

Canceling an order
If you want to cancel an order before we have dispatched, please email us at: retail@cigalacycling.com

Please note that we pride ourselves on our quick turnaround time, this does mean there is only a small window to cancel your order. If you notice a mistake please cancel as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

Although we will try our best to assist you we cannot guarantee we will be able to stop your order in time to prevent it from being dispatched.

Orders that have already been processed and dispatched can be canceled within 14 days of being received and must then be returned to Cigala Cycling Retail within a further 14 days as per your consumer rights.
You have rights under The Consumer Contracts (Information, Cancellation and Additional Charges) Regulations 2013 which state that up to 14 days after receiving your goods, in most cases, you can change your mind and get a full refund. You have the right to cancel this contract within 14 days from delivery without giving any reason. This right does not apply to any customised or personalised goods bought through our website. To exercise this right please contact us prior to the expiry of the cancellation rights period.

If you cancel this contract, we will reimburse to you all payments received from you, including the costs of delivery (except for the supplementary costs arising if you chose a type of delivery other than the least expensive type of standard delivery offered by us). However, you are responsible for paying the return delivery charges.

We may make a deduction from the reimbursement for loss in value of any goods supplied, if the loss is the result of unnecessary handling by you.

We will make the reimbursement without undue delay, and not later than:

14 days after the day we received back from you any goods supplied; or
(if earlier) 14 days after the day you provide evidence that you have returned the goods; or
if there were no goods supplied, 14 days after the day on which we are informed about your decision to cancel this contract.
We will make the reimbursement using the same means of payment as you used for the initial transaction, unless you have expressly agreed otherwise; in any event, you will not incur any fees as a result of the reimbursement.

Once the order has been canceled you will receive a confirmation email. If not dispatched orders that have been paid at checkout will be automatically refunded, any other payment methods would not have been charged so would not be due a refund. Orders that have been dispatched will be refunded at the point the good are received back with us. Unfortunately orders that have been canceled cannot be reactivated, so if you change your mind, please place a new order in the usual way.

The item must be:

-In saleable and undamaged condition;
-In its original unopened and sealed packaging; and

This policy is in addition to, and is not intended to limit, any rights or remedies you may have under the Consumer Guarantees Act.
This policy does not impact your rights where a product may be faulty, damaged, or incorrectly supplied. If an item is faulty/damaged/incorrectly supplied, we will meet our obligations under the Consumer Guarantees Act to provide a remedy.
Faulty goods, depending on the manufacturer would normally have a 2 years EU warranty from the date of purchase.
Your warranty begins with your purchase date. Should you need to file a claim and receive a replacement unit, the warranty period on the replacement unit will continue from your original purchase date.
This covers manufacturing defects, but does not cover damage sustained by crashing, abuse, or general wear and tear. If you think your goods are faulty please contact us prior to returning them.

Cigala Cycling is a retailer, not a wholesaler. Our aim is to inspire everybody, every day and everywhere to experience the joy of sport, not to act as a wholesaler supporting B2B sales. As such, we reserve the right to cancel excessive orders of individual products without notice. Please contact customer service for further information on this matter.

Pre-order policy
When you place a pre-order with us, we contact the appropriate distributor and place the order. If the item is available, we will then get order confirmation which we then confirm with you, along with the ETA. At this point, we have committed to the pre-order and can no longer cancel the item without penalty. Therefore, please be very sure when placing your pre-order as there are cancellation fees incurred if you change your mind. The cancellation fee for a pre-order is equal to 30% of the total amount, which for some orders of large amounts such as bikes, that is the non-refundable deposit that is required when placing the pre-order.

Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA)
ETA's can vary and are not guaranteed arrival date. We list the date given by manufacturer, but delays can and do happen. We cannot cancel your pre-order, even if delays are substantial, so please take this into account when ordering. We regularly update the product listing with the latest ETA. Keep an eye on the listings after you order to see when your product is due to arrive.

Settling a Pre-Order When It Arrives
When your item arrives we will contact you to settle any balance due and arrange shipping.
Orders must be settled within 7 days of the product coming into stock. Failure to settle within this period may mean you lose your pre-ordered item.

Prices quoted can be subject to change as items are only billed by manufacturers when they ship to us. We do everything we can to give you an accurate buy price, but pre-orders that are far away can vary in price if exchange rate varies from now until then. 

Postage fees can also vary depending on the size of the product, type of shipping and number of boxes required. We suggest you pre-order each item individually as that way each pre-order's postage is paid separately and can ship as it comes into stock.

KICKR BIKE Return Terms & Conditions
Because of the size and weight of the KICKR BIKE, when returning KICKR BIKE (New, inactivated) due to changing your mind, you will be charged a restocking fee of €225. This fee is inclusive of the costs associated with any packing material to secure the KICKR BIKE for return shipment. You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning the item.

Shipping Policy

1. Shipping Rates

Republic of Ireland & Northern Ireland

  • Free shipping on orders over €100 via Courier Express Tracked Service.

  • Orders under €100:

    • Express Courier Tracked Service (1–3 business days): €7.95


European Union (EU)

  • Orders under €100: €19.95 via Standard Courier Tracked Shipping (3–5 business days).

  • Orders between €100 & €200: €14.95 flat rate via Standard Courier Tracked Shipping (3–5 business days).

  • Orders over €200: €9.95 flat rate via Standard Courier Tracked Shipping (3–5 business days).

Bulky / Heavy Items

  • Certain products such as indoor trainers, bikes, or scooters incur additional shipping charges due to size and weight. Charges are calculated at checkout.

  • Example: KICKR BIKE V2, KICKR BIKE PRO and KICKR BIKE SHIFT: €150.

  • Delivery times for bulky products may be longer for remote locations.

  • Bulky items cannot be combined to one order: example: 2 o 3 Indoor Trainers under the same address. If you need multiple Heavy Items, which you see the category based on shipping charge at checkout, please place multiple orders.

Canceling an order
Please note that once an order has been shipped, cannot be cancelled. 
If the order has been shipped, and you no longer want the product, please follow our return policy.

2. Shipping Restrictions

  • We ship only within the EU. For some countries or regions, due to logistics or brand restrictions, certain products cannot be shipped outside the Republic of Ireland.

  • We do not ship to forwarding companies. Orders placed with forwarding addresses will be cancelled and refunded.

  • A local phone number is mandatory for EU deliveries. Failure to provide a local number will result in order cancellation.

3. Shipping Times

  • Shipping times are estimates only. They start 1–3 working days after the order is placed as they are based on couriers schedules and service availability. 

  • Typical delivery times:

    • Ireland & Northern Ireland: 1–3 business days

    • EU (Standard): 3–5 business days

  • Shipping times may be longer during holidays or to remote areas. Please allow extra time in such cases.

4. VAT, Duties & OSS Compliance

  • Cigala Cycling Ltd is the seller of record for all orders. We collect and remit VAT for EU orders via the One-Stop Shop (OSS) system.

  • EU customers: Prices include all VAT; nothing additional to pay on delivery.

  • Non-EU customers: Import duties, customs fees, or taxes may apply. These are not collected by Cigala Cycling Ltd and are the responsibility of the recipient.

  • For all packages, we declare the full transaction value as required by law.

5. Products Shipped Directly from EU Distributors

  • Some items may ship directly from our EU distributors.

  • Cigala Cycling Ltd remains the seller of record, and all products are invoiced by us.

  • We handle all customer service, including order confirmation, tracking, delivery questions, returns, and warranty claims.

  • Lead times may vary depending on distributor location, stock, and courier services. Estimated delivery times are provided on the product page.

6. Pissei Custom Clothing Orders

  • Lead time is approx. 6 weeks, plus 1 week delivery, after the club confirms the graphics and order.

  • Orders placed individually via the online store start the lead time when all club orders are received and the club closes the store.

  • Minimum order quantities (MOQ) must be met by the club. Orders below MOQ cannot be shipped.

  • Custom orders cannot be cancelled, returned, or refunded.

7. Shop Safe – EU Assurance

  • Cigala Cycling Ltd is based in the Republic of Ireland, part of the EU.

  • For EU customers, all prices include VAT and duties, so there is nothing additional to pay on delivery.

  • For non-EU customers, local import duties, taxes, and customs charges are the customer’s responsibility.

8. Failed or Refused Deliveries

  • If a package is not picked up or is refused, it will be returned to us. The recipient will be charged:

    • Standard packages: Ireland €10, EU €15

    • Bulky / heavy items: Ireland €25, EU €60

  • Duties and taxes remain payable if applicable.

9. Bicycle Assembly & Delivery

Bicycles purchased through Cigala Cycling Ltd are ordered from the manufacturer or distributor specifically for the customer and may be shipped directly from the brand or distributor to the delivery address.

Depending on the manufacturer and bicycle model, the bicycle may arrive partially assembled in order to comply with the manufacturer's packaging and transportation requirements. This may include, but is not limited to, installation or adjustment of the handlebars, controls, cables/hoses, pedals and bar tape.

Due to the use of integrated and internally routed cables and hoses on some models, certain components may not be fully installed before shipment.

We recommend that any final assembly, adjustment and safety checks are carried out by a qualified bicycle mechanic or professional bike shop before the bicycle is ridden.

The customer should not ride the bicycle until all required assembly and safety checks have been completed.

Where applicable, the manufacturer may provide assembly instructions or specify particular assembly requirements. Customers should follow these instructions and any manufacturer recommendations.

This does not affect or limit any statutory consumer rights or remedies that apply to the purchase under applicable Irish or EU consumer law.
